measure: Economiser: each 20 K reduction in flue-gas temperature
note: Rule of thumb; an economiser lowers gas-boiler flue gas to about 120-130 degC (biomass boilers about 160 degC). Strictly applies to combustion efficiency.

note: Recommended air temperature 80-90 degC (Bosch); requires a duoblock burner with separate fan.

Condensing heat exchanger on natural-gas boiler, return temperature 45 / 40 / 30 degC
note: At 50 degC return hardly any condensation. Not fully additive to an existing economiser. Rough evaluation range 3-8% of fuel energy (p.29). reprinted from IBS (no year)

measure: Steam-trap maintenance programme (annual survey, repair or replacement)
note: About 10% of traps fail per year in a maintained system, reducible to about 5%; about 30% faulty after 3-5 years without survey. Cost about EUR 300 per trap (European Commission 2009). PRICE YEAR NOT STATED; publication year 2020 used.
